pages.content:
# Best AI Agent in India: Pricing, Privacy and Workflow Fit

India-specific evaluation needs more than converting USD to INR. Cursor's official India announcement lists its Start plan at ₹649 per month, tax inclusive, billed in INR with UPI or card. For other vendors, buyers should verify billing currency, tax invoices, payment methods, support and data-processing terms directly.

## Privacy context

The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 has a staged commencement timeline, so this page does not apply a blanket DPDP-compliant label to products. Teams should identify the actual processing activity, determine which provisions apply on the deployment date, and obtain appropriate legal or compliance review for regulated workflows.

## Pilot checklist

Define one workflow, restrict permissions, verify current vendor terms, test language and integration requirements, document human approval points, and measure cost under expected usage. Preserve logs and rollback steps for consequential actions.
